title: Add persistent unresolved-sale research state

next_research_policy.reason: sale 0 now has a persisted research attempt while sale 1 at the same contribution rank has not yet been researched through the original-source recovery pass

guarantees: A failed original-source research attempt is persisted without changing market-record verification state.
Research attempt metadata is structurally validated in CI.
Never-researched unresolved candidates are selected before already-attempted unresolved candidates.
Verified sales and identity mismatches are excluded from the unresolved research queue.
No sale price, EV contribution, original-marketplace verification flag or candidate assessment status is changed by a failed research attempt.
